title: Evolution of hypersurfaces in $(n+1)$-dimensional light-cone
summary: In this paper, we investigate the evolutionary processes of hypersurfaces within half of the $(n+1)$-dimensional light-cone. Depending on the evolutionary processes, our focus extends to exploring variational problems associated with a smooth function $f(S_1,\cdots,S_n)$, where each $S_r$ denotes the $r$-th elementary symmetric polynomial, defined as the sum of all possible products of $r$ distinct principal curvatures. We present several fundamental properties related to these variational problems. Furthermore, we examine a curvature-type flow defined locally within the light-cone,…
